purpose: Teach: 完売/手形/再販/増収/不問/別個/特産/海苔

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、防犯グッズが本日完売しました
lines.en: The crime prevention goods sold out today.
lines.style: Measured, official opening. Even pace, no inflection. Factual delivery, like reading from a report. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、手形偽造の事件を捜査されてますね
lines.en: Yes — you're investigating the counterfeit bill case, aren't you.
lines.style: Acknowledgment with a note of understanding. Respectful but conversational. Slight lean of attentiveness. Not deferential, but cooperating.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、再販された違法薬物の摘発を進めております
lines.en: We're continuing to crack down on the redistribution of illegal narcotics.
lines.style: Formal, bureaucratic phrasing. Deliberate pace. 「摘発を進めております」carries quiet authority. No emotion, just procedure.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、増収詐欺の手口にご注意なさってますね
lines.en: Yes — and you're being careful about the advance-fee fraud schemes too, right.
lines.style: Light acknowledgment. Genuine curiosity underneath. Not testing, just checking in. Warm but measured.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者の経歴は不問とせず、警察、調査します
lines.en: We're not overlooking the suspect's background — we're investigating it thoroughly.
lines.style: Slight emphasis on 「不問とせず」. Deliberate correction, not harsh. Professional firmness. Clear that this matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、別個の事件として警察、扱われますね
lines.en: Yes — each case is being handled separately, as it should be.
lines.style: Quiet agreement. Understands the reasoning. Nods slightly. Respectful tone, no sarcasm. Matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、地域特産品の偽造事件も捜査中です
lines.en: We're also investigating the counterfeiting cases involving local specialty products.
lines.style: Continuing through the list. Same measured pace as before. No weariness, just procedural thoroughness. Professional stamina.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、海苔の不正取引事案も対応されてますね
lines.en: Yes — and you're handling the illegal nori trading cases as well.
lines.style: Specific detail shows he's been paying attention. Warm recognition. Slight smile in the voice, not mocking. Genuine respect for the work.
